inv.desc_en:
� Unique Opportunity in the Heart of La Sagrera! �

Dolça Llar Sagrera exclusively presents a magnificent commercial space for transfer with a C3 license, located in a high-traffic commercial area in the center of La Sagrera.

✔️ Restaurant in full operation, with a loyal clientele, excellent reputation, and outdoor terrace. Ready to start working from day one!

⭐ Fully equipped:

Professional kitchen with multiple burners, oven, griddle, dishwasher, freezer, and more.

Bar with refrigerators, coffee maker, microwave, glasses, plates, and shelves.

Several TV screens, security cameras throughout the premises.

Complete furniture: tables and chairs for interior and terrace (currently 6 tables, with the possibility of expanding).

Storage area, changing room for employees, and 2 bathrooms (one adapted for people with reduced mobility).

✔️ Direct access from the street, which guarantees maximum visibility and convenience for both customers and staff.

If you are looking for a place ready to continue a profitable activity and with all the details taken care of, this is your opportunity!

� Contact us now for more information and to schedule your visit.

Your new gastronomic project starts here.
